The system enforces a compositional hierarchy where the Tier-1 wow is not negotiable unless explicitly overridden. Bespoke assets ensure uniqueness and prevent commoditization, while motion composition principles enforce reuse and scalability. Failure occurs when any of these constraints are violated, such as using stock assets or skipping the scroll-scrub journey.
